identity.name: Heron Bay
identity.notes: Master-planned gated community in Parkland, FL (ZIP 33076), established 1998 and completed 2017. Over 3,025 residences across 34 distinct neighborhoods spanning Parkland and Coral Springs. Managed by KW Property Management & Consulting (KWPMC). Features over 100 acres of lakes and wetlands, two renovated clubhouses, and 24/7 gated security with manned gatehouse and patrols. One of South Florida's most impressive master-planned communities with resort-style amenities. Median home price approximately $960,000.

fees.note: Resident-verified range of $400–$500/mo. A second source (hoabulletinboard.com) reports $345–$400/mo depending on property type and sub-association. Exact current amounts, transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments are not detailed in publicly available sources. No special assessment signals reported. Verify directly with the association (KWPMC, (954) 575-2200).

Reported range of $345–$400/mo depending on property type and sub-association. Exact current amounts, transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments not detailed in publicly available sources.

Resident-submitted range $400-$500/mo per HOA Agent aggregator (profile updated Jul 11, 2026); not official HBCA figure. No special assessment signals reported for this community on that site. Managed by KWPMC (KW Property Management & Consulting). Verify with the association directly. (Range upper bound $500.)

Local real-estate blog: monthly dues typically $300-$550 depending on sub-village and whether the section has extra private amenities (range upper bound $550). Fee covers master clubhouse, resort-style pools, tennis and pickleball courts, fitness center, and 24-hour guard-gated entry. Community is HOA-based, not CDD-based.
No CDD assessment: Heron Bay is HOA-based, not CDD-based (per local blog). CDD assessments apply to newer Parkland construction (e.g., MiraLago), not to Heron Bay.

amenities.detail: Resort-style clubhouse with fitness center and spa; two clubhouses total (North and South)
North Clubhouse (modernized 2020, accommodates up to 250 guests, resort-style amenities and entertainment spaces) and South Clubhouse (own set of recreational facilities)
Multiple swimming pools including resort-style pool, children's pool, and splash pad
Fitness center in clubhouse
Spa facility in clubhouse
Tennis courts
Pickleball courts
Basketball courts
Soccer field
Extensive walking and biking trails connecting various neighborhoods
Over 100 acres of lakes and wetlands with preserved natural areas and water features
24-hour gated security with manned gatehouse and patrols; multiple gates and long boulevards create a park-like setting

Two clubhouses: Plaza Del Lago (north end, Osprey Trail) and The Commons (south end, Heron Bay Blvd); both renovated, hours Mon-Fri 5am-9:50pm, Sat/Sun 7am-9:50pm; men's and women's locker rooms at both. (Official HOA site.)

Resort-style heated pool with kids' spray park, waterfall feature, poolside chairs/umbrellas, and grill area at Plaza Del Lago; spacious swimming pool with Jacuzzi, cabana bar, and island-style water features at The Commons. (Official HOA site.)
Modern fitness centers at both clubhouses with state-of-the-art cardio and strength equipment; aerobics studio with weekly classes at Plaza Del Lago. (Official HOA site.)
Sauna and treatment rooms at Plaza Del Lago. (Official HOA site.)

The Commons: ten Hydro-Grid clay courts plus two hard-surface courts, tennis shop, two full-time tennis professionals, monthly round-robin tournaments; expanded tennis and pickleball facilities. (Official HOA site.)
Expanded pickleball facilities at The Commons. (Official HOA site.)
Indoor racquetball court at The Commons. (Official HOA site.)
Basketball courts at both Plaza Del Lago and The Commons. (Official HOA site.)
Banquet ball rooms at Plaza Del Lago seating up to 250 guests; party/ballroom with catering kitchen and meeting room at The Commons. (Official HOA site.)
Newly opened waterpark at Plaza Del Lago. (Official HOA site.)

24-hour guard-gated entry (covered by HOA dues); community is a collection of gated sub-villages inside one larger gated perimeter. (Local real-estate blog; buyer notes also cite manned gatehouse and patrols.)

open_questions: HOA fee ranges conflict across sources: $400-$500/mo (HOA Agent, resident-submitted), $300-$550/mo (South FL Insider blog), and $345-$400/mo (HOA Bulletin Board search snippet, page not read). Verify current dues with HBCA/KWPMC ((954) 575-2200 per HOA Bulletin Board snippet).

Golf course: a realtor marketing site (homesatheronbayparkland.com, snippet only) claims an 18-hole championship golf course, but the local blog states there is NO golf course inside Heron Bay (often confused with neighboring Parkland Golf & Country Club) and the official HOA amenities page does not mention golf. Needs verification.
Median age: Census QuickFacts search snippet reported 37.9 years for Parkland, but the figure did not appear in the page content I read; left null.

No verified distances to nearest hospital, library, grocery, or shopping center. Parkland has no downtown commercial corridor by design (per local blog); residents drive to Coral Springs or small commercial pockets for errands.
Pet policy, short-term rental restrictions, and rental approval rules: unknown (HOA Agent lists all as unknown).
